description: This PHP file defines a driver class for Microsoft ADO database connections (`ADODB_ado`) and its associated `ADORecordSet_ado` class. It provides methods for connecting to the database, executing queries, managing transactions, and fetching schema information specific to the ADO driver implementation, indicating it is part of a database abstraction layer for PHP applications.

classes.name: ADODB_ado
classes.description: Database driver class for connecting and interacting with MS Access and MS SQL Server via ADO, including methods for schema inspection, query execution, and transaction control.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ado
classes.description: Represents a record set returned from an ADO database query, supporting field fetching, row iteration, and type conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the ADODB_ado class, initializes affectedRows property.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of affected rows.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection using provided hostname, username, password, and provider options.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of database tables.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query, with optional prepared statement support.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message from the database connection.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error code from the database connection.
